messages:
Sasha M: quick sanity check - the new 'ld-compact-v2' embedding shows ~6pt drop in recall@10 on the wiki short-title holdout, but long-form queries look fine. clustering density also seems noisier :thinking_face:
Matt R: saw that this morning, ran a tiny shard of the evalset. recall@10 went 0.82 -> 0.76 for topk 10 on titles only. full-doc recall unchanged.
Jing Li: could be L2 vs cosine mismatch in downstream index. did we switch normalization in the pipeline for compact variants?
Sasha M: good call. the model outputs are unnormalized floats now (we changed postproc for perf). I pushed a quick notebook to check: https://rdw/repo/emb/evals/ld-compact-check.ipynb
Alina P: if outputs are unnormed, indexing with cosine will distort nearest neighbors. can we try normalizing at ingest and at query to compare?
Matt R: did a quick experiment: normalized vectors restore recall to ~0.81 but still shy of baseline 0.82. so normalization helps but doesn't fully recover.
Jing Li: leaving note — small quantization shift might be moving cluster centroids. did you run per-channel int8 vs symmetric int8?
Sasha M: model was exported with per-tensor quant (for perf). I can re-export per-channel int8 and rerun tonight.
Matt R: also opened a KNN sanity script to dump nearest neighbors for a few failing titles, will paste examples shortly.
(eval-bot): batch eval job 1768505000 started: ld-compact-v2 | wiki-shorttitles | seed=42
Matt R: example fail: query "Apollo 11 mission" — baseline neighbors include ["Apollo 11", "Lunar landing", "Neil Armstrong"] ; ld-compact neighbors include ["Apollo 11", "Saturn V", "Moon landing ceremony"] — not catastrophically wrong but lower exact-title recall.
Jing Li: can you run UMAP with 2000 random title vectors and color by domain? curious if compact has collapsed some subclusters.
Sasha M: running clustering / density metrics now (using hdbscan + silhouette). quick outputs: baseline silhouette 0.41, ld-compact-v2 0.28. density ratio (intra/inter) baseline 3.2, ld-compact 1.9.
Alina P: that drop in silhouette is telling. could be embedding space smoothing from the compression objective. check dimensional energy (per-dim variance) to see if info concentrated in fewer dims.
Matt R: nailed it — per-dim variance shows top 20 dims explain 70% variance in ld-compact, vs top 60 dims in baseline. so effective rank reduced.
Sasha M: plan: (1) re-export with per-channel int8 and run eval-bot sweep, (2) try post-export whitening to rebalance dims as a temporary fallback, (3) run normalized-index recall and a small re-ranking test. ok?
Jing Li: yep. tagging @Alina P for help on whitening config.
Alina P: happy to help, I have a whitening transform script. one caveat: whitening can hurt semantic monotonicity for some queries — we'll validate with the evalset.
(eval-bot): batch eval job 1768505000 completed: recall@10 normalized-index=0.80, non-normalized=0.74, silhouette=0.30
Sasha M: thanks everyone. I'll post a short PR with per-channel export + README for the eval differences. if we still lose >2pts after per-channel int8 we'll consider keeping baseline or doing a rollout with fallback routing by query type. :thumbsup:
Matt R: sounds good. ping me when the PR is up, I'll run the larger cluster stability checks.
Jing Li: adding a small set of failing-title probes to the regression tests so this doesn't regress silently.
Alina P: will add whitening candidate to the 'quick-fixes' doc and note potential side effects.
Sasha M: closing loop here once per-channel runs are in. thanks!"
